Phoebe Waller-Bridge originally didn't even want to make a second season of Fleabag, feeling the story was already complete. She only agreed to return once she cracked the "Hot Priest" dynamic-and she specifically wrote this Therapist role for legendary actress Fiona Shaw while they were working together on Killing Eve.

The series  won six Primetime Emmy Awards in 2019, including Outstanding Comedy Series, because its raw look at grief, humor, and connection struck a deep chord with viewers and critics alike.
